'''Harvest tunic''' is a part of a set together with [[Straw hat]] that increases the player's [[Farming (Skill)|Farming skill]] by +25 so long as both pieces are worn. The [[Harvest dress]] can be used in place of the tunic for the same effect. It is sold by [[Hildir]] after retrieving and bringing her the [[Hildir's Chests|Brass chest]].
